technology_name: Microbial Biofertilizer for Healthy Coconut Seedlings
problem_solved: Challenges in raising healthy coconut seedlings.
description: KeraProbio® is a microbial biofertilizer formulated using Bacillus megaterium, a rhizobacterium with multiple plant growth-promoting properties isolated from healthy coconut palms. The microorganism is mixed with talc powder to prepare the formulation. Its application helps in raising healthy coconut seedlings
applications:
Coconut seedling production and nursery management
Biofertilizer application in coconut cultivation
Sustainable nutrient management in plantations
Organic and eco-friendly agricultural practices
Plant growth promotion and root development programs
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
